author: Debug01-dEoW aka Deep
description: EcoDot 1.28v — Featuring a redesigned Liquid Glass customizable Equalizer & hardware Bass Boost, SimpMusic-style cross-reinstall Backups with scheduled auto-backup timings, Liquid Glass Album & Artist experiences, single-row Followed Artists in Library, unified queue gestures, and a slim ~6.8 MB R8 release APK crafted by Debug01-dEoW aka Deep.

News & Highlights: **Major 1.28v Feature Update**: Upgrades all `1.26v` and `1.27v` users in-place cleanly with Liquid Glass Equalizer, Backup & Auto-Backup Timing, Liquid Glass Album & Artist views, and Library Followed Artists carousel.
**Customizable Liquid Glass Equalizer & Bass Boost**: Live cubic frequency response curve, custom saved/deletable presets, flat reset, dynamic device bands, and hardware Bass Boost.

**SimpMusic-Style Full Library Backup & Timing**: Exports and restores playlists, Liked Songs, followed artists, history, searches, profile/avatar, EQ presets & preferences to Downloads or custom SAF folders with Daily/3-Day/Weekly/Monthly auto-backup schedules.

**Slimmer, Faster & Hardened APK**: Trimmed unused dependencies, consolidated onto SimpIcons & Moshi, stripped debug logs via R8, hardened MediaSession permissions, and aligned Compose BOM 2025.12.01.
New: **Equalizer Presets, Reset & Bass Boost**: Save and delete custom named EQ presets, reset all bands cleanly to flat (0 dB), view dynamic frequency curves, and dial in hardware `BassBoost` + `Virtualizer`.

**Cross-Reinstall Backup & Restore (`EcoDotBackupManager`)**: Full `.ecodot` archive export/import, persistable SAF backup folders, shared `Downloads/EcoDot` auto-backups, and scheduled auto-backup checks.
**Album Batch Controls**: Added Play, Shuffle, Save/Saved bookmark, Download Entire Album with live progress & offline delete, Queue Album, Play Album Next, Add All to Playlist, and Share Album.
**Followed Artists Single Row in Library**: Followed artists now render directly in a clean horizontal carousel inside `Your library` with quick scroll focus and long-press unfollow.
Improved: **Liquid Glass Album & Artist Screens**: Frosted headers, luminous borders, ambient blurred artwork backdrops, expandable Popular Tracks (`Top 5` / `See all`), and real Artist channel metadata.
**Apple Music Queue Gestures & Batched Home Queue**: Added drag-to-reorder and swipe-to-remove to Apple Music Queue and batched Home multi-track queue additions.
**Real Inline Now Playing Metadata**: Replaced seeded artist rank/subscriber multipliers and track play-count estimates with honest video metadata and real subscriber counts.
Fixed: Fixed custom EQ band sliders resetting to flat when the playback service restarted.
Removed distracting `MV` overlay pills from Home music video cards.
Tightened `EcoDotSessionService.onConnect` authorization, scoped `backup_rules.xml` & `data_extraction_rules.xml`, and removed unnecessary `USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT` permission.

changelog:
## News & Highlights
• **Major 1.28v Feature Update**: Upgrades all `1.26v` and `1.27v` users in-place cleanly with Liquid Glass Equalizer, Backup & Auto-Backup Timing, Liquid Glass Album & Artist views, and Library Followed Artists carousel.
• **Customizable Liquid Glass Equalizer & Bass Boost**: Live cubic frequency response curve, custom saved/deletable presets, flat reset, dynamic device bands, and hardware Bass Boost.
• **SimpMusic-Style Full Library Backup & Timing**: Exports and restores playlists, Liked Songs, followed artists, history, searches, profile/avatar, EQ presets & preferences to Downloads or custom SAF folders with Daily/3-Day/Weekly/Monthly auto-backup schedules.
• **Slimmer, Faster & Hardened APK**: Trimmed unused dependencies, consolidated onto SimpIcons & Moshi, stripped debug logs via R8, hardened MediaSession permissions, and aligned Compose BOM 2025.12.01.

## New
• **Equalizer Presets, Reset & Bass Boost**: Save and delete custom named EQ presets, reset all bands cleanly to flat (0 dB), view dynamic frequency curves, and dial in hardware BassBoost + Virtualizer.
• **Cross-Reinstall Backup & Restore**: Full `.ecodot` archive export/import, persistable SAF backup folders, shared `Downloads/EcoDot` auto-backups, and scheduled auto-backup checks.
• **Album Batch Controls**: Added Play, Shuffle, Save/Saved bookmark, Download Entire Album with live progress & offline delete, Queue Album, Play Album Next, Add All to Playlist, and Share Album.
• **Followed Artists Single Row in Library**: Followed artists now render directly in a clean horizontal carousel inside `Your library` with quick scroll focus and long-press unfollow.

## Improved
• **Liquid Glass Album & Artist Screens**: Frosted headers, luminous borders, ambient blurred artwork backdrops, expandable Popular Tracks (`Top 5` / `See all`), and real Artist channel metadata.
• **Apple Music Queue Gestures & Batched Home Queue**: Added drag-to-reorder and swipe-to-remove to Apple Music Queue and batched Home multi-track queue additions.
• **Real Inline Now Playing Metadata**: Replaced seeded artist rank/subscriber multipliers and track play-count estimates with honest video metadata and real subscriber counts.

## Fixed
• Fixed custom EQ band sliders resetting to flat when the playback service restarted.
• Removed distracting `MV` overlay pills from Home music video cards.
• Tightened `EcoDotSessionService.onConnect` authorization, scoped backup XML rules, and removed unnecessary full-screen intent permission.
